notes: אֲשֶׁר with the resumptive adverb שָׁם shares the single where under rule 22's fusion sentence, headed on the relative; שָׁם is the clause's predicate, so the construction-supplied copula joins that unit (rule 20), discontinuous under rule 25.
The italic to sleep is one added unit: laid down has already written שָׁכַב's lexeme and no morpheme names the sleeping (rules 2, 44). The italic corroborates and does not decide it (rule 7).
Every construct in the verse has an anarthrous rectum, so each takes a supplied the under rule 29.
